subject: forestpath
name: 林间小路
label: 林间弯曲的小径
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. A gently winding forest path framed by one broadleaf tree and two tall conifers, clear joined trunks and large canopy masses, no individual leaves.
STRICT: five large structures ONLY: one broadleaf tree, two conifers, and two curving edges of an EMPTY path. Broadleaf tree has ONE smooth canopy with 6 broad lobes and two branching lines. Each conifer has three large tier shapes, not dozens of twig tips. Trunks have NO bark lines. NO grass, shrubs, leaves, stones, pebbles, ground detail, hatching or texture. Pure black outline on WHITE, generous 10 percent margin.
